rationale: Follow-up check round for CR-001 through CR-005 from code-review-final.json. All five patch findings have been addressed in commit 8613b4250. CR-004 (None payload crash): `payload = payload or {}` guard added at the top of `_create_mcp_auth_error`. CR-003 (TypeError on dict error_context): `str(s['error_context'])` coercion applied in the join. CR-001 (tautological oauth assertion): replaced `assert 'oauth' not in details_text.lower() or 'oauth' in details_text.lower()` with `assert 'oauth/start' not in details_text.lower()`, targeting the actual auth_location fragment. CR-002 (missing spec-required test): `test_manual_model_401_returns_401_payload_unchanged` added — raises MCPAuthenticationRequiredException through `_ask_assistant`, asserts the original exception is re-raised unwrapped (`exc_info.value is auth_error`) and payload shape is unchanged. CR-005 (vacuous token-leak test): exception message now includes `http://server?token=secret-token` so the assertion `'secret-token' not in all_logged` is no longer vacuous. No production code changed beyond the two-line guard in `_create_mcp_auth_error`. All previously passing spec/story-ac items remain green. No new findings introduced.
